Gordon Vale and the much improved Phil Vesty of Leicester with Mike Nicholls and Stephen Marshall backing up it was the Belgrave Title again.

It was Paul Blagg who was first home for Bels and despite his long injury, induced lay-off he was proving to be back on form. A Section: 1.P.Vesty (Leic) 13.393m; 3.P.Blagg 13.267; 11.J.Newnham 12.563; 15.
A fine win for Phil Vesty (Leic) in the second fastest time ever, followed home by Mike Parker (Brighton). Carl was first home in 6th place and Richard three places down.

After one lap of the hills Phil Vesty, Leicester's young star was leading from Dave Jarman of SWC and Adrian James of Enfield. Carl led the rest of the field with our lads battling it out to be in our scoring team.

Yet again it was Leicester's young P.Vesty who came home in front with Belgrave's three packing in behind (4 to score). 1.P.Vesty 44.10; 2.R.Dorman 46.24; 3.A.Trigg (Leic) 46.32; 4.C.Lawton 46.34; 5.J.Newnham 47.40.
Richard Dorman failed by 6 seconds to beat Leicester's Phil Vesty for 1st. And lower down the field Percy Wright competed for the first time for many years.
Individual winner was Phil Vesty, winner two years ago, although not so fast. As it was it was fortunate for us that Leicester did not bring a strong 4th man as they had 3 in 6.
